title: Algorithm Plugin Input Arguments
description: A schema for algorithm plugin input arguments

class_names.title: Class Names
class_names.description: Names for every class according to their index of the model prediction (separated by commas). Otherwise, specify the number of classes.

aug_library.title: Augmentation Library Name
aug_library.description: Indicate the augmentation library to extract from (default and only available library: albumentations)

severity_before.title: Before Severity (string)
severity_before.description: Indicate the extent of severity to compare to (before) (leave blank if using integer)

severity_after.title: After Severity (string)
severity_after.description: Indicate the extent of severity to compare to (after) (leave blank if using integer)

severity_before_idx.title: Before Severity (integer)
severity_before_idx.description: Indicate the extent of severity to compare to (before, as integer index) (leave blank if using string)

severity_after_idx.title: After Severity (integer)
severity_after_idx.description: Indicate the extent of severity to compare to (after, as integer index, if not using string) (leave blank if using string)

custom_parameters.title: Custom Parameters
custom_parameters.description: Custom parameters for the augmentation_method(s) (default for no custom params: None)
